name: iExalt, Inc.
summary: iExalt, Inc. furnishes a comprehensive suite of products, services, and online solutions designed for Christian families, businesses, schools, communities, and organizations. Its current offerings encompass filtered internet access and a range of published Christian content, including electronic books, reference materials, an events magazine, a business directory, and a newspaper. The company also broadcasts the "Life Perspectives" radio program five evenings a week and is affiliated with a Christian radio show geared towards younger audiences. Digitally, iExalt manages an extensive contemporary Christian music website, operates an artist agency for Christian performers, sells tickets for various Christian gatherings, and oversees a popular Christian web portal. Furthermore, its platform provides access to online sermon resources and distributes a rich, monthly digital newsletter for local youth initiatives. Established in 1999 and headquartered in Houston, Texas, iExalt, Inc. functions as a religious and charitable trust supporting the Christian community.
